history.summary: Shri Shri Radha Krishna Mandir, a small community Hindu temple in Churachandpur (Lamka), Manipur, dedicated to Radha and Krishna. Directory listings place it on Tiddim Road (795133) / Lighthouse Lane, Jangnomphai (795128), i.e. central Churachandpur. Local reviews describe it as a spiritual hub for the town's Hindu devotees with daily rituals, bhajans, classical dance and music programs, and celebrations of Janmashtami and Radhashtami. Churachandpur is overwhelmingly Christian, so the temple is a small minority institution; its founding date is undocumented. Coordinates are approximate - verify on the ground.

name: Radha-Krishna Temple
town_description: Churachandpur, also called Lamka, is the second-largest town in Manipur and the headquarters of Churachandpur district, about 60 km southwest of Imphal on the Tiddim Road. It is the main urban centre of the hill tribes (Kuki-Zo communities) and is overwhelmingly Christian; Hindu shrines are few and small. The district borders Myanmar and the town serves as the region's principal market and administrative hub.

travel.airport: Imphal International Airport (IMF), ~60-65 km by Tiddim Road (verify)
travel.railway: No railway station in the district; nearest railheads are Dimapur (Nagaland) and Silchar (Assam), 150+ km away (verify)
